title: UltimateTPA
description: A lightweight Paper plugin that is DonutSMP-inspired and adds a clean teleport request system with /tpa, /tpahere, /tpaccept, /tpdeny, /tpauto, and /tpasettings.
body:
# UltimateTPA

UltimateTPA is a lightweight and customizable teleport request plugin for Paper servers.  
It provides a smooth `/tpa` system with countdowns, sounds, and player settings — without unnecessary clutter.

---

## ✨ Features

- ✅ `/tpa` and `/tpahere` request system
- ✅ Clickable chat to accept requests
- ✅ `/tpaccept` and `/tpdeny`
- ✅ `/tpauto` (auto-accept requests)
- ✅ Teleport countdown system
- ✅ Cancel teleport when player moves
- ✅ Configurable sounds (pling, ice chime, etc.)
- ✅ Fully customizable messages
- ✅ Player settings GUI (`/tpasettings`)
- ✅ Reload command (`/tpareload`)
- ✅ Lightweight & optimized for performance
- ✅ Supports Paper 1.21+

---

## 📦 Commands

| Command | Description |
|--------|------------|
| `/tpa <player>` | Send a teleport request |
| `/tpahere <player>` | Ask player to teleport to you |
| `/tpaccept [player]` | Accept a request |
| `/tpdeny [player]` | Deny a request |
| `/tpauto` | Toggle auto-accept |
| `/tpasettings` | Open settings menu |
| `/tpareload` | Reload plugin config |

---

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|-----------|------------|---------|
| `ultimatetpa.reload` | Allows `/tpareload` | OP |

---

## 🔊 Sounds

UltimateTPA uses **Minecraft sound keys**, not `.ogg` files directly.

Examples:
- `block.note_block.pling` (countdown)
- `block.note_block.icechime` (request received)
- `entity.enderman.teleport` (teleport)

You can fully customize these in `config.yml`.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

- `config.yml` → sounds, delays, behavior
- `messages.yml` → all messages
